scope: Execute the experimental ACI resource and register boundaries, not sound emulation.

tests.test: 8/16/32-bit bus-master accesses use MMIO at the ACI +0x100 aperture and preserve the stdcall ABI
Rejects PC I/O-port resources, absent IRQs, extra memory/DMA resources, absent descriptors and undersized MMIO
Mapping failures propagate without touching unmapped registers; maps only 0x180 uncached bytes
Absent surround/LFE codec registers return not-supported without an MMIO write
